font_inputs.note: Input count is not a family count or a count of fonts shipped in the present release. Mixed, inherited and generated layers retain their own methods.

limits.detail: Some Windows and Source Han records identify the actual face/weight but lack a historical font-file hash. Current inspected versions cannot supply that missing identity; affected images are listed in font-evidence.md. Current Windows TTC material renderers establish index 0 from their actual API calls.

Not every old output was pixel-replayed. PM sound-only tutorial pm:rio000:0x6544f288 has a known Noto Sans SC input/profile; its older layout replay remains separate from font identification. All 10 current AGE2 boot textures now reproduce the released RGB pixels.
The MEB author page was not readable in this audit. Existing source and author-use notices are retained; this is not a fresh complete authorization verification.

This conclusion applies to the enumerated retained records and reachable Git history as of the audit date. Deleted records and unprovided private material cannot be reconstructed by visual font guessing.

privacy: Only sanitized identities, material relationships and evidence hashes are published. Private conversations, local paths, original art and font binaries stay out of Git.
